title: Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
quotes: Would the fall never come to an end?

author: Lewis Carroll
quotes: Beware the Jabberwock, my son!
He took his vorpal sword in hand:
The vorpal blade went snicker-snack!
O frabjous day! Callooh! Callay!

title: Moby-Dick
author: Herman Melville
quotes: Call me Ishmael.
Yes, as every one knows, meditation and water are wedded for ever.

author: Mary Shelley
quotes: What may not be expected in a country of eternal light?
Inspirited by this wind of promise, my daydreams become more fervent and vivid.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
quotes: It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune must be in want of a wife.

quotes: There are really four dimensions, three which we call the three planes of Space, and a fourth, Time.

author: H. G. Wells
quotes: And early in the twentieth century came the great disillusionment.

author: L. Frank Baum

You mought call me captain.

author: Henry David Thoreau
quotes: Simplicity, simplicity, simplicity!

author: William Blake
quotes: Tiger, tiger, burning bright In the forests of the night,

And I made a rural pen, And I stained the water clear,

title: The Raven
author: Edgar Allan Poe
quotes: Once upon a midnight dreary, while I pondered, weak and weary,
Deep into that darkness peering, long I stood there wondering, fearing,
Quoth the Raven, “Nevermore.”
Darkness there and nothing more.
